DDoS.what: a distributed flood aimed at exhausting the target's bandwidth or connection table
DDoS.action: Rate-limit or blackhole the target upstream and block the top source subnets at the firewall.

DoS Hulk.what: an HTTP flood generating large numbers of unique requests
DoS Hulk.action: Rate-limit HTTP per source, enable the web server's request throttling and block the source.

DoS GoldenEye.what: a keep-alive HTTP flood that pins server worker threads
DoS GoldenEye.action: Lower keep-alive timeouts, cap connections per IP and block the source.

DoS Slowloris.what: a slow-header attack that holds connections open with partial requests
DoS Slowloris.action: Reduce header read timeouts, cap concurrent connections per IP, use a reverse proxy.

DoS Slowhttptest.what: a slow-body / slow-read attack that starves the server of sockets
DoS Slowhttptest.action: Set minimum data-rate limits on request bodies and block the source.

Port Scan.what: reconnaissance probing many ports to discover exposed services
Port Scan.action: Block the scanner, review which ports answered and close anything not meant to be public.

SSH Brute Force.what: repeated SSH login attempts guessing credentials
SSH Brute Force.action: Block the source, enforce key-only SSH, and check auth logs for any successful login.

FTP Brute Force.what: repeated FTP login attempts guessing credentials
FTP Brute Force.action: Block the source, disable plain FTP in favour of SFTP, and audit FTP accounts.

Web Brute Force.what: automated guessing against a web login form
Web Brute Force.action: Add login rate-limiting / CAPTCHA, block the source, and force resets on targeted accounts.

Web XSS.what: attempts to inject scripts into web application parameters
Web XSS.action: Review the targeted endpoint's output encoding and add a Content-Security-Policy.

Web SQL Injection.what: attempts to inject SQL through web application input
Web SQL Injection.action: Block the source, review the endpoint for unparameterised queries, check DB logs.

Botnet.what: command-and-control communication from a likely compromised host
Botnet.action: Isolate the internal host, scan it for malware and block the C2 address network-wide.
